mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, increasing corporate revenue visibility and reducing recession risk, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 950.0 and RSAFS > 435000.0 in same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in interaction-triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal fails to outperform individual proxies in out-of-sample Rank IC > 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in real output, increasing the probability of a near-term recession, which triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressures that may prompt the Fed to delay rate cuts, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5 in 3 consecutive months and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during interaction-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal fails to achieve Rank IC < -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
